_comment: Cue list for the apartment. Run `npm run sfx` to generate every entry with ElevenLabs into this folder. Any cue without a file falls back to the built-in WebAudio synth, so the game is playable either way. `prompt` is the ElevenLabs text prompt; `duration` is in seconds; `loop` asks ElevenLabs for a seamless loop.

sfx.name: footstep.wood
sfx.prompt: single soft barefoot step on a hardwood floor in a small apartment, close mic, dry, no reverb tail

sfx.name: footstep.rug
sfx.prompt: single muffled footstep on a thick wool rug, soft, dry, close mic

sfx.name: footstep.tile
sfx.prompt: single bare foot step on kitchen vinyl flooring, slight tacky sound, dry close mic

sfx.name: bed.rustle
sfx.prompt: person shifting under a duvet, cotton bedsheets rustling, close and intimate

sfx.name: bed.creak
sfx.prompt: wooden bed frame creaking as someone sits up, single low groan of timber

sfx.name: fridge.open
sfx.prompt: refrigerator door seal peeling open, suction release, bottles shifting slightly inside

sfx.name: fridge.close
sfx.prompt: refrigerator door thumping closed, rubber seal, solid low thud

sfx.name: fridge.bottles
sfx.prompt: glass bottles and cans clinking gently on a fridge shelf

sfx.name: fridge.hum
sfx.prompt: steady refrigerator compressor hum in a quiet apartment kitchen, low drone, seamless loop

sfx.name: can.crack
sfx.prompt: aluminium beer can tab cracking open, sharp hiss of carbonation escaping

sfx.name: can.sip
sfx.prompt: person taking a swig from a cold beer can, liquid glugging, close mic

sfx.name: can.set
sfx.prompt: aluminium can set down on a wooden table, light hollow clunk

sfx.name: can.crush
sfx.prompt: empty aluminium can crushed in one hand, metal buckling and crinkling

sfx.name: switch.click
sfx.prompt: light switch toggled on, single crisp plastic click

sfx.name: radio.click
sfx.prompt: chunky vintage stereo power button clicking, mechanical

sfx.name: radio.tune
sfx.prompt: analogue radio tuning dial sweeping across stations, brief squeals and static

sfx.name: radio.static
sfx.prompt: soft untuned FM radio static hiss from small speakers, seamless loop

sfx.name: door.knob
sfx.prompt: interior door handle turning, latch clicking, no door opening

sfx.name: door.locked
sfx.prompt: apartment front door handle rattling against a locked deadbolt, twice

sfx.name: window.blinds
sfx.prompt: venetian blinds being raised, plastic slats clattering upward

sfx.name: frame.adjust
sfx.prompt: picture frame nudged against a wall, faint wood and glass tap

sfx.name: clock.tick
sfx.prompt: single tick of a small wall clock, dry and quiet

sfx.name: pc.boot
sfx.prompt: desktop gaming PC powering on, fans spinning up, single motherboard beep

sfx.name: pc.fan
sfx.prompt: quiet desktop computer case fans running steadily, smooth airflow, seamless loop

sfx.name: pc.keyboard
sfx.prompt: single mechanical keyboard keypress, tactile brown switch

sfx.name: pc.mouseclick
sfx.prompt: single gaming mouse left click, crisp and light

sfx.name: chair.sit
sfx.prompt: person sitting down into a padded gaming chair, gas cylinder compressing slightly

sfx.name: chair.roll
sfx.prompt: office chair castors rolling a short distance over a hard floor

sfx.name: ambience.city
sfx.prompt: distant early morning city ambience heard through a closed apartment window, faint traffic, no voices, seamless loop

sfx.name: ambience.room
sfx.prompt: quiet empty apartment room tone, very low hum, seamless loop

sfx.name: arcade.hit
sfx.prompt: retro arcade impact, chunky bass thud with a short digital crunch, 16-bit style

sfx.name: arcade.miss
sfx.prompt: retro arcade whiff, short descending blip, 16-bit style

sfx.name: arcade.roar
sfx.prompt: short guttural bigfoot roar, deep and gravelly, monster vocal

sfx.name: arcade.combo
sfx.prompt: retro arcade combo chime, two rising square wave notes

sfx.name: arcade.golden
sfx.prompt: retro arcade bonus jingle, sparkling ascending arpeggio, 16-bit style

sfx.name: arcade.hurt
sfx.prompt: retro arcade damage sound, harsh descending buzz, 16-bit style

sfx.name: arcade.wave
sfx.prompt: retro arcade level start fanfare, three rising square wave notes

sfx.name: arcade.gameover
sfx.prompt: retro arcade game over jingle, slow descending square wave melody, 16-bit style

sfx.name: ui.select
sfx.prompt: soft interface confirm blip, warm and short

sfx.name: ui.hover
sfx.prompt: very soft interface hover tick, quiet
